findings.text: A committed change to a gated test file the dispatch did not grant is carried with the node, and the manifest reports status complete while its blockers field records the write-time audit refusing this path twice.

Two scripts and tests/standard_names/test_vocabulary_definitions.py:9 are also outside the declared fence; the manifest lists the scripts only inside evidence_inputs.ungranted_scripts and omits the vocabulary test from outside_scope.

_OWNER_BY_NAME is a 501-entry hand-written symbol-to-owner map with no check binding it to the modules or to srtj-graph-ops-split-design.json, so the next move makes resolve_owned_name raise AttributeError at a call site rather than at a check.

_GraphServices.__getattr__ resolves every moved name dynamically, so graph_ops.<moved symbol> still succeeds after the retirement and a caller drifting back is caught by no test, only by the codemod run by hand.
artifacts.default_base_summary, default_head_summary and graph_base_exit describe superseded runs and disagree with the final gate logs the record cites.
The added guard selects forwarders by the docstring prefix 'Forward to ', so a reintroduced forwarder described otherwise, or reintroduced in workers.py, passes unnoticed.
